title: Research: a stronger P112 two-call COPY floor for arbitrary cross forms
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

For two independent P112 root-code decoders with arbitrary directed binary cross forms, prove that `c01+c10 >= min(8,r01,r10)` forces the exact separate-total COPY minimum **128**. Here `r` denotes global cross-form rank and `c` the minimum rank on allowed support hyperplanes. A term touching both calls costs at least `16-min(8,r01,r10)` by a block Schur complement; combining this with PR2294's coefficient-count argument yields the new criterion.

The resulting rank-only test certifies 93 of 100 ordered rank pairs in 0..9. The explicit rank-(4,4) example has support minima (3,3): PR2294's earlier `c01+c10>=8` test is inconclusive, while this theorem proves minimum 128. Sixteen coordinate terms attain it. Seven low-rank pairs remain undecided by the rank-only test.

This is a scoped written proof with exact finite premises and three Lean-checked natural-number interface theorems. The binary/complex matrix arguments and P112 support implications are not fully formalized. No physical supplier, rank-power moment, kappa improvement, selected-frontier change or independent human review is claimed.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3, standard library; Lean 4.21.0 core, commit `6741444a63ee`.

```sh
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-cross-form-rank-tradeoff --check-only
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-cross-form-rank-tradeoff
python3 -I -O -B research/p112-cross-form-rank-tradeoff/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/p112-cross-form-rank-tradeoff/test_integrity.py
lean +leanprover/lean4:v4.21.0 -j1 research/p112-cross-form-rank-tradeoff/CountFloor.lean
python3 -I -B research/p112-cross-form-rank-tradeoff/check_lean.py --lean /path/to/lean
```

Expected finite marker: `PASS_P112_CROSS_FORM_RANK_TRADEOFF ranks=93/100 blocks=9216 decoders=505 controls=8 abstentions=1`.

The checker independently reconstructs the Hamming-shell roots, checks 12,544 label pairings, both 511-functional support censuses, all 64 within-call support ranks, all 9,216 invertible-diagonal 2-by-2 block cases and 505 exact decoder fixtures. Five 16-dimensional coefficient identities imply the full 224-by-224 scalar demands using the checked left inverse. One deliberately degenerate rank-(1,1) form makes the sufficient test abstain.

Normal, optimized and registered replays pass. Five integrity tests cover Git-free relocation, live source and predecessor drift, a false receipt and integer-to-Boolean receipt corruption. Lean checks three conditional arithmetic theorems and four concrete counterexamples; four false proofs reject. The theorem axiom audits contain only `propext` and `Quot.sound`. The Python registration does not build Lean; the separate command does.

Not checked: the seven residual rank classes in full, matrix premises in a proof assistant, all cross-form matrices by enumeration, physical embedding/hosting/precision, rank-power moments, full selected cold replay, hosted CI or independent human review. These checks are not required to claim the scoped COPY-floor theorem. The selected record is byte-for-byte unchanged.

The registered replay and the Lean check (Lean 4.21.0: three theorems that rely only on `propext` and `Quot.sound`, four rejected proofs) were run again on the final package bytes before submission, under an 8 GiB memory cap; both passed in a few seconds and left the worktree unchanged. The worked example checks by hand: ranks (4,4) with support minima (3,3) satisfy 3 + 3 = 6, at least min(8,4,4) = 4, so the new test applies, while PR #2294's test needs a sum of at least 8.

## Open next questions

The package README and TASK.json identify two bounded follow-ups: classify the remaining small-rank forms when the actual support-minimum criterion fails, starting with rank-one annihilator hyperplanes; and formalize the binary/complex matrix-to-count premises, starting with the Schur bound. Finite fixture costs do not settle the residual minima. Physical realization remains a separate question.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The current board's explicit PR2294 open question and exact source pins enabled a focused continuation. A claim index keyed by object and changed hypothesis, across task-card names, would reduce simultaneous semantic collisions more effectively than filename reservations alone.
